title: Owner-only `postgres` backup credential is reachable from any agent-pushed or agent-dispatched ref (repository secret, no environment or ref binding)
description: docs/backup.md says only the owner registers SUPABASE_BACKUP_DATABASE_URL and that the URI must never be sent to the agent, yet it names the agent as the one who dispatches the backup workflow. The credential is the `postgres` owner role of the sole production Supabase database (backup_private.py:45). It is set up as a repository secret, and backup-private.yml declares no `environment:` and no ref condition. Any identity that can push a branch and dispatch workflows (the AI agent sessions, which push branches and open PRs in this repo, or any other write collaborator or app) can therefore run backup-private.yml on its own branch. On that branch, scripts/backup_private.py, which receives the secret, is attacker-controlled. It can print the URI (for example base64-encoded to defeat masking), use it to write to the database, or encrypt the full dump to its own age key or none. The workflow then uploads that file as an artifact, which any signed-in user can download from a public repository. A second path needs no dispatch: same-repo pull_request runs (db-checks.yml, deriva.yml, which are required checks on every PR) execute the PR's own workflow definitions, so a PR branch that edits a workflow can reference any repository secret. Agent-authored commits in history (883640b, 9d9e594) modified workflow files, and the CHANGELOG records a temporary branch-pushed workflow that produced a database backup artifact. The auditor credential SUPABASE_TEST_AUDIT_DATABASE_URL is exposed the same way to same-repo PR code, contrary to phase3-security.yml:84 ('o secret não é exposto a PRs'), but its authority is minimal. The decisive facts are GitHub panel state: the secret's scope and the agent identity's permissions.
claimed_root_cause: Secrets that grant authority above a branch writer are stored at repository scope and consumed by workflows whose code comes from a caller-selected ref (workflow_dispatch at any ref, same-repo pull_request). No GitHub Environment with a main-only deployment branch policy and owner approval binds them to reviewed code, so the documented boundary 'agent dispatches, but never receives the URI' is enforced by nothing.

trace.description: Manual dispatch with no input or ref restriction. Job `backup` (line 16) has no `environment:` and no `if:` on github.ref, so a dispatcher can run the workflow and scripts from any branch it pushed.

trace.scope: jobs.backup.steps['Dump, restauração, todas as contagens e criptografia'].env
trace.description: The repository secret SUPABASE_BACKUP_DATABASE_URL (and BACKUP_AGE_PUBLIC_KEY at line 71) is injected into the step that runs `python3 scripts/backup_private.py` (line 73), checked out from the dispatched ref.
The script, as it exists on the caller's branch, reads the raw URI from the environment. All later handling, including the age recipient check at line 125, is code the caller controls.
The accepted credential is user `postgres.gontnlfmothfglssbyyk`, the database owner role with read/write authority over every schema, not a minimal read-only backup login.

Second path: same-repo PRs run the PR's own workflow files with repository secrets (fork PRs are skipped by the if: at line 79). A PR branch can add `${{ secrets.SUPABASE_BACKUP_DATABASE_URL }}` to any job. deriva.yml:47 behaves the same way.

trace.scope: jobs.backup.steps['Publicar somente o pacote criptografado aprovado'].with.path
trace.description: Whatever file the caller's script leaves at this path is uploaded as an artifact (repository public per docs/adr/0003-repositorio-publico.md), and anything it prints goes to the run log. The postgres credential or a plaintext full dump leaves the owner-only boundary.

evidence.description: Setup instructs 'Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret' for both backup secrets, so the scope is repository-wide, not environment.
Intended boundary: 'Só o dono cadastra; nunca enviar a URI ao agente/chat.'
'O agente dispara e acompanha o workflow.' The principal barred from the URI is the designated dispatcher.
Precedent: a backup was produced by 'um workflow temporário disparado por push na branch' (lines 1367-1369), so branch-pushed workflow code has received backup credentials in this repository.
Claims the auditor secret 'não é exposto a PRs', but db-checks.yml:83/101/131 and deriva.yml:64 hand the same secret to PR-head code: a lower-impact variant of the same scoping gap.
The only branch control is the main ruleset: PRs and checks, 'não exige aprovação humana'. Nothing restricts which refs secret-bearing workflows run from.

blockers: Not source-observable: whether SUPABASE_BACKUP_DATABASE_URL and BACKUP_AGE_PUBLIC_KEY are currently configured, and whether they are repository/organization secrets or restricted to a GitHub Environment. The docs say repository secret, and backup-private.yml declares no environment, so an environment-only secret would not resolve.

Not source-observable: the GitHub identity and permissions the AI agent sessions (Claude Code / Codex) push and dispatch with (Contents write, Actions write for workflow_dispatch with an arbitrary ref, Workflows permission), and whether other write-level collaborators or apps exist.
Not source-observable: repository/organization Actions policies that could restrict which refs or actors may run workflows.

validation_plan.deployment: Owner, in the GitHub web UI: (1) Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions: record whether SUPABASE_BACKUP_DATABASE_URL and BACKUP_AGE_PUBLIC_KEY appear under Repository secrets (finding holds) or only under an Environment with deployment-branch and reviewer protection (finding does not hold). (2) Settings → GitHub Apps and Collaborators: record the Contents, Actions and Workflows permissions of the identity the agent sessions use. (3) Safe confirmation without the real secret: in a throwaway repository, create a repository secret DUMMY=marker, have the agent identity push a branch whose script prints only the secret's length, then dispatch the workflow on that branch. A printed length proves agent-chosen code receives repository secrets. Remediation to verify: move both backup secrets into an Environment (e.g. `backup-integral`) limited to `main` with the owner as required reviewer, and add `environment: backup-integral` to jobs.backup.
validation_plan.local: Regression after the fix: render the workflow trigger/secret/environment matrix (as in agents/h17-ci-secrets/artifacts/check-02.out). Require jobs.backup in backup-private.yml to declare the protected environment, and require that no job reachable from pull_request or from an unrestricted dispatch references SUPABASE_BACKUP_DATABASE_URL.
